findings.title: Conditions with no values
findings.message: In rule "Pilot stores", the custom field store_id condition (any) has no values, so it matches no user.
findings.action: Add the values the rule was meant to target, or delete the condition.

findings.title: Targeting values that will not match
findings.message: In rule "Staff", the email condition (any) has leading or trailing spaces in "n…@acme-pantry.example "; a domain one letter away from acme-pantry.example in "t…@acme-pantry.exmple".
findings.action: Fix the listed values in the rule. For long lists, move them into an ID list segment.

findings.title: References to missing, archived or disabled entities
findings.message: It is assigned to layer growth_layer_v0, which does not exist.
findings.action: Point the rule at the right gate or segment, or remove the condition. Restore the target if it was archived by mistake.

findings.title: Experiments without a hypothesis or the right metrics
findings.message: Running with no secondary or guardrail metrics.
findings.action: Write the hypothesis (what changes, for whom, which metric moves and by how much), pick the primary metrics, and add guardrail metrics.

findings.title: Experiments without a hypothesis or the right metrics

findings.action: Write the hypothesis (what changes, for whom, which metric moves and by how much), pick the primary metrics, and add guardrail metrics.

findings.title: Running experiments with failing health checks
findings.message: Health checks failed: Exposures are balanced (failed).
findings.action: Open the experiment's diagnostics, fix the cause, and restart the experiment if the assignment itself was broken.

findings.title: Experiments whose targeting gate lets nobody in
findings.message: Its targeting gate old_search_ranking returned false on every check for 30 days.
findings.action: Point the experiment at a working targeting gate, or fix the gate's rules.

findings.title: Experiments whose targeting gate lets nobody in
findings.message: Its targeting gate churn_survey is disabled, so it returns false.
findings.action: Point the experiment at a working targeting gate, or fix the gate's rules.

findings.title: Gates and configs whose rules keep changing
findings.message: 8 rule or state changes in the last 7 days, by 3 people. Its own review setting is off and the project does not require reviews.
findings.action: Find out why it keeps changing. Turn on required reviews for it, and move values that are tuned often into a dynamic config.

findings.title: Gates Statsig marked stale
findings.message: Marked stale: no checks in the last 30 days. Last changed 120 days ago.
findings.action: Confirm no code still checks it, then archive it.

findings.title: Gates Statsig marked stale
findings.message: Marked stale: returned false on every check for 30 days. Last changed 63 days ago.
findings.action: Remove the check from code and keep the false path, then archive the gate.

findings.title: Gates Statsig marked stale
findings.message: Marked stale: launched, or an everyone rule passes 100%. Last changed 75 days ago. Statsig marked it stale on 2026-10-02.
findings.action: Remove the check from code and keep the launched path, then archive the gate.

findings.title: Launched or disabled gates past their cleanup window
findings.message: Disabled and unchanged for 70 days, so every check returns false.
findings.action: Remove the check from code and keep the default path, then archive the gate.

findings.title: Launched or disabled gates past their cleanup window
findings.message: Launched and unchanged for 94 days, so every check returns true.
findings.action: Remove the check from code and keep the launched path, then archive the gate.

findings.title: In-progress gates that serve everyone the same value
findings.message: In Progress, but it serves true to everyone (rule "Everyone" passes 100%). Unchanged for 52 days.
findings.action: Launch the gate (or mark it permanent if it is a kill switch), then remove the check from code.

findings.title: Partial rollouts left alone
findings.message: Still partial: rule "Beta 25%" at 25%. Unchanged for 41 days with no scheduled rollout step.
findings.action: Finish the rollout to 100% or roll it back to 0%, then launch or disable the gate. If the split is on purpose, mark the gate permanent or add it to the ignore list.

findings.title: Gates with no traffic
findings.message: No production checks in the last 7 days, confirmed by Statsig. Created 40 days ago.
findings.action: Search the code for the gate name. If nothing checks it, archive it. If something should, fix the name in code.

findings.title: The same ID list pasted into several entities
findings.message: The same 6 email values also appear in gate test_gate_copy.
findings.action: Create an ID list segment with these values and replace each inline list with a passes_segment condition.

findings.title: Rules that can never run
findings.message: Rule "Everyone" matches everyone, so the rule after it never runs: rule "Staff".
findings.action: Move the everyone rule to the bottom, or delete the rules below it.

findings.title: Experiments without a hypothesis or the right metrics
findings.message: In setup with no hypothesis, no primary metric and no secondary or guardrail metrics.
findings.action: Write the hypothesis (what changes, for whom, which metric moves and by how much), pick the primary metrics, and add guardrail metrics.

findings.title: Several comparisons with no correction
findings.message: 3 primary metrics and 3 groups, with no Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
findings.action: Turn on Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg correction in the experiment's advanced settings, or cut it to one primary metric and one test group.

findings.title: Running experiments decided by metrics nobody vouched for
findings.message: Hidden from the catalog, and it is a primary metric of running experiment delivery_eta_display.
findings.action: Have the metric owner review and verify the definition, or switch the experiment to a verified metric before reading results.

findings.title: Running experiments decided by metrics nobody vouched for
findings.message: Not verified, and it is a primary metric of running experiment checkout_button_copy.
findings.action: Have the metric owner review and verify the definition, or switch the experiment to a verified metric before reading results.

findings.title: No required review for changes
findings.message: Project settings do not require a review for config changes. A team-level setting may still require one for some teams.
findings.action: Turn on required reviews for config changes in the project settings. Metric reviews matter once metrics decide launches.

findings.title: Missing description, owner or tags
findings.message: Has no description, an API key as owner instead of a person and no tags.
findings.action: Add a one-line description of what the entity controls, assign an owner, and tag it with the team or area.

findings.title: Layers no experiment uses

findings.action: Archive or delete the layer if code no longer reads its parameters. Keep it if a new experiment is about to use it.
